name: rfc-agent-marketplace

plugins.name: rfc-agent
plugins.description: PRD to grounded tech RFC: Scope, Investigate, Draft, Review, Revise, Summarize. Every claim about existing code is cited to a file and line and checked by deterministic gates. Writes out/rfc.md and a short out/rfc.readable.md.

plugins.name: test-agent
plugins.description: QA test cases from an RFC run, from chat: preflight, generate, evaluate, upload to Kiwi for review, prerequisites, then backend, web UI (Playwright) and app UI (Maestro) execution after you confirm the cases. Needs rfc-agent installed.

description: Marketplace for the rfc-agent plugin (grounded tech RFCs from PRDs) and the test-agent plugin (QA suites from those RFCs).
